Requirement: Evaluate historical-replay and shadow recommendations without operational effects.
Notes: Both read-only semantics are executable against synthetic fixtures; historical_case_count=0, no live feed is connected, and Phase 2.1 does not claim shadow-deployment progression.

Requirement: Ingest a versioned replay manifest and local canonical JSONL snapshot.
Notes: Canonical local JSONL only; no URL, archive, wildcard, stream, or vendor-network ingestion.

Requirement: Validate structural, semantic, and governance requirements before processing.
Notes: Manifest and governance failures abort; FAIL_DATASET validates the case set as one unit; QUARANTINE_RECORD allows only reviewed case-local defects and retains code-owned fatal whole-call conditions.

Requirement: Normalize valid event ordering while preserving mapping and temporal-ordering warnings.
Notes: Canonical key is observed_at, collected_at, source_type, source_instance, event_id; EVENT_ORDER_NORMALIZED is retained per affected case.

Requirement: Reject duplicate identifiers and capture record-specific reasons.
Notes: Duplicate case/event IDs are sanitized fatal whole-call conditions; reviewed ordinary defects retain stable category/code metadata in qualification and rejection artifacts without payload text.

Requirement: Execute the frozen model, policy, and verifier in decision-only mode.
Notes: The harness snapshots the selected model and policy, runs only those bytes through a read-only ExecutionMode, and reverifies the snapshot after execution.

Requirement: Preserve proposed actions solely as counterfactual recommendations.
Notes: counterfactual_actions are retained while proposal.executable_actions and action_results remain empty.

Requirement: Keep adjudications physically and logically separate from runtime input.
Notes: The adjudication file is distinct, frozen with run inputs, excluded from qualification, and decoded only after accepted-case decisions and read-only safety checks complete.

Requirement: Emit decisions, rejections, audit, data-quality, replay-metrics, and run-manifest artifacts.
Planned_or_Implemented_Artifacts: src/adf_poc/replay/harness.py; src/adf_poc/replay/metrics.py; qualification_accounting.jsonl; rejections.jsonl; normalization_diagnostics.json; replay_decisions.jsonl; replay_audit.jsonl; replay_metrics.json; replay_run_manifest.json
Notes: Qualification and rejection artifacts are emitted only when QUARANTINE_RECORD is selected and are hash/count-bound in the run manifest; default FAIL_DATASET behavior remains available.

Requirement: Record model, policy, contract, adapter, input, and deterministic-output versions or hashes.
Planned_or_Implemented_Artifacts: data/phase2_starter/manifest.json; data/phase2_qualification/manifest.json; config/phase2_replay.json; config/phase2_qualification.json; src/adf_poc/replay/harness.py; replay_run_manifest.json
Notes: The run manifest records contract/adapter/policy selection; exact snapshotted input digests/counts; deterministic artifacts including qualification/rejections when enabled; and current-run volatile decision/audit hashes.

Requirement: Produce a closed metadata-only qualification ledger and exact quarantined projection for every governed nonblank case occurrence.
Notes: Ledger records contain only governed source identity, line ordinals, hashes, status, and stable error values; accepted errors are empty and no payload or free-form reason field exists.

Requirement: Replay and shadow modes shall issue zero authorization tokens.
Notes: Read-only engine construction omits AuthorizationGate and authorization.issued remains false.

Requirement: Replay and shadow modes shall invoke zero action brokers.
Notes: Read-only engine construction omits ActionBroker and the harness rejects nonzero broker counts.

Requirement: Replay and shadow modes shall attempt zero operational effects.
Notes: execution_control.operational_effects is zero; post-action verification is explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE with passed=null; and the harness rejects ACTION_EXECUTED, ACTION_REJECTED, or POST_ACTION_VERIFIED audit records.

Requirement: Unknown or contradictory execution configuration shall fail closed.
Notes: Unknown, synthetic-simulation, lowercase, or live-like Phase 2 modes and live_actions_enabled=true are rejected; QUARANTINE_RECORD is rejected for SHADOW_READ_ONLY.

Requirement: No live connector or live-action capability shall exist in Phase 2.
Notes: No LIVE enum, live-enablement parameter, network adapter, write-capable client, or action credential exists.

Requirement: Reject historical input lacking replay approval or de-identification attestation.
Notes: All Phase 2 inputs require explicit approval, deidentified=true, and direct_identifiers_present=false; attestation is not proof of effective de-identification.

Requirement: Prohibit labels and adjudication fields from runtime replay records.
Notes: Forbidden keys are detected recursively; label contamination is fatal rather than quarantinable, and the separate adjudication file is never passed to the engine.

Requirement: Abort complete record qualification when source access, integrity, record-boundary, parser-resource, contract-version, label-separation, identifier-uniqueness, or classifier-completeness cannot be established.
Notes: Source-read, encoding, line-size, JSON-nesting, version, label, duplicate-ID, count, digest, and unmapped-validator failures return sanitized fatal errors and no accepted subset; immediate and continuation-read fault injection proves operating-system text is not echoed.

Requirement: Verify manifest input digests and record counts before processing.
Notes: Every declared file is checked before decisions; the qualifier independently verifies its frozen source digest; exact snapshots are rechecked after execution; mismatch aborts.

Requirement: Retain provenance and event-level traceability for accepted evidence.
Notes: Normalization preserves provenance_id and event IDs; decisions retain input, cited-evidence, and feature-trace event references.

Requirement: Hash-chain audit every replay decision and execution-suppression event.
Notes: The harness verifies the presented chain; requires one suppression, no-authorization, and finalization record per decision; and recomputes/cross-checks every decision hash. The chain is not independently anchored or WORM-protected.

Requirement: Bind every run to immutable-in-run copies of the configuration, manifest, model, policy, cases, and adjudications actually used.
Notes: The harness copies verified inputs to output/input_snapshot, loads only snapshot bytes, and reverifies all snapshot digests/counts after engine execution and before finalization.

Requirement: Confine configuration and manifest-relative paths beneath their allowed roots.
Notes: Absolute, traversal, and resolved escape paths fail closed; output cannot be the repository root or a nonempty directory.

Requirement: Treat the evaluation environment as a threat boundary and record isolation, egress, dependency, credential, monitoring, containment, termination, and residual-risk controls.
Verification_Evidence: scripts/validate_claim_evidence.py; planned sandbox-escape and covert-egress campaign
Notes: The claim contract requires explicit environment fields and the starter declares its same-process limitations; no OS-enforced isolation or adversarial escape evaluation has been completed.

Requirement: Prevent record qualification and rejection artifacts from disclosing rejected payloads, payload-derived identifiers, paths, or raw validator errors.
Notes: Closed schemas and sanitized exceptions retain only line/source hashes and code-owned metadata; hashes remain linkable and require restricted handling for historical data.

Requirement: Equivalent inputs shall produce identical semantic decisions excluding declared volatile engine/audit fields and shall produce byte-identical qualification artifacts.
Notes: Qualification run identity, ledger, and rejection artifacts are deterministic for identical governed input; deterministic decision/comparison/metrics artifacts remain stable while raw engine/audit artifacts are volatile.

Requirement: Run offline after declared dependencies are installed.
Notes: The starter opens only confined local files and exposes no network client or URL ingestion.

Requirement: Under the explicit offline qualification policy, process contract-valid cases when another case has a reviewed record-local defect; abort all cases on any code-owned fatal condition.
Notes: Seven synthetic inputs yield three accepted decisions and four quarantined records; default FAIL_DATASET and all fatal classes still abort the complete case set.

Requirement: Cover every read-only execution-guard branch with automated tests.
Notes: Both read-only modes, synthetic compatibility, prohibited construction, and absence of a live mode are covered.

Requirement: Cover valid, malformed, stale-version, duplicate, and governance-failure contracts.
Notes: Tests cover malformed JSON, missing/extra fields, absolute/traversal/symlink paths, versions, timestamps, ranges, duplicates, bounds, governance, context consistency, labels, digests, and counts.

Requirement: Demonstrate a high-risk containment recommendation with zero authorization and effects.
Notes: At least one automation-eligible synthetic case retains counterfactual containment while authorization, broker, and effect counters remain zero.

Requirement: Detect audit tampering and manifest digest changes.
Notes: The suite mutates an audit record and a declared digest and verifies fail-closed detection.

Requirement: Test runtime inputs for label leakage.
Notes: Top-level and nested forbidden fields are rejected and evaluator-only data is not passed to the engine.

Requirement: Keep all Phase 1 tests passing.
Planned_or_Implemented_Artifacts: tests/test_dataset_and_pipeline.py; tests/test_safety_controls.py; tests/test_execution_modes.py; tests/test_replay_contracts.py; tests/test_replay_harness.py; tests/test_replay_qualification_unit.py; tests/test_replay_qualification.py; tests/test_qualification_fixture_generator.py; tests/test_claim_evidence.py
Notes: Full suite passes 67 tests, including the unchanged Phase 1 regression tests.

Requirement: Bind every published Phase 2 result to an explicit claim class, system configuration, scope, validity assessment, evidence artifacts, review state, limitations, and prohibited inferences.
Notes: P2-CE-001 binds the three-case starter and P2-CE-002 binds the fixed seven-record qualification campaign. Both remain self-reviewed CE-2 synthetic controlled-behavior records with explicit nonclaims and finite expiry.

Requirement: Test behavior under matched evaluation-aware, deployment-framed, and neutral conditions before making an alignment claim.
Notes: The current deterministic POC has no autonomous generative agent; evaluation-awareness testing becomes mandatory if one is introduced.

Requirement: Evaluate reward/test hacking, code sabotage, sandbagging, and oversight-undermining pathways before claiming robustness to strategic misbehavior.
Verification_Evidence: Planned mutation testing, sandboxed side tasks, and independent red-team evaluation
Notes: Passing repository tests is a release gate, not evidence that these adversarial capabilities are absent.

Requirement: Measure monitor recall, precision, false-negative rate, latency, coverage, and human-response effectiveness on an adjudicated adversarial corpus before making a monitoring-efficacy claim.
Notes: No operational monitor corpus or bounded false-negative estimate exists.

Requirement: Obtain blind internal-independent and external-independent evaluation before operational-readiness claims.
Verification_Evidence: Planned blind red/blue hidden-objective audit and third-party rerun
Notes: The starter evidence record is self-reviewed.

Requirement: Report raw numerators, denominators, exclusions, failures, data origin, uncertainty assumptions, and configuration-specific results without converting 0/n into zero risk.
Verification_Evidence: tests/test_claim_evidence.py; tests/test_replay_qualification.py; planned statistical review for historical evaluation
Notes: Synthetic results preserve 3/3 starter cases and 7=3+4 qualification intake with explicit non-inferences; representative historical sampling, missingness, and uncertainty analysis are unavailable.

Requirement: Maintain a dated, auditable coverage screen of applicable Anthropic and OpenAI safety, agent, cyber, evaluation, monitoring, and governance research before changing a claim or phase gate.
Notes: The register records the 2026-08-14 screen, inclusion/exclusion logic, current disposition, unresolved obligations, and refresh triggers; it is a dated baseline rather than a permanent completeness claim.

Requirement: Evaluate cumulative trajectory authority, outcome composition, instruction retention, intervention latency, pause, and incident-derived regression behavior for any future long-horizon agent.
Verification_Evidence: Planned trajectory campaign with sequence-level known truth
Notes: The deterministic starter has no long-horizon generative agent; isolated action checks would not establish trajectory safety.

Requirement: Validate any automated grader against blinded expert known truth and quantify grader disagreement, nondeterminism, and susceptibility to manipulation.
Verification_Evidence: Planned grader qualification set and adversarial judge tests
Notes: Starter outcome checks are deterministic; no model-based grader is used or qualified.

Requirement: Separate correct decisions, consequential errors, investigation, escalation, and abstention using disposition- and consequence-specific counts.
Notes: The starter preserves per-disposition counts and explicit synthetic origin, but three designed cases cannot establish operational calibration or asymmetric-risk rates.

Requirement: Predeclare and verify a mixed-quality synthetic qualification campaign with exact status/reason outcomes, accounting, deterministic artifacts, tamper resistance, and zero effects.
Notes: Seven nonblank synthetic cases produce three accepted decisions and four quarantines with one each of INVALID_JSON, MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD, INVALID_TIMESTAMP, and CANONICAL_CONTEXT_MISMATCH; tokens, brokers, and effects remain zero.

Requirement: Generate and check the reviewed synthetic qualification fixture without source-read inconsistency or filesystem alias overwrite.
Notes: Generator pins reviewed-source digests, uses one source-byte read for hashing and parsing, confines an exact target set, and rejects symlink redirection, hard-linked targets, and unreviewed target entries.

Requirement: Assign claim ownership, expiry, revalidation triggers, incident gates, and pause or revocation authority for every published result.
Notes: The CE-2 record contains lifecycle fields and a finite expiry; the review is self-review and no operational authorizing authority is asserted.
